steps.inboxRaise: Sign in to the payroll application
Sign in to the payroll application

sheets.title: Access › Requests, a request raised — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: A request is raised in a vault with no Identity API and no Host. Before, the request sits in the list and nothing else on the device knows it waits. After, the Requests tab carries a status mark naming it, and the bell in the status line is lit.
sheets.before: status marks on the page: none
sheets.after: status mark: "1 request waiting" on the Requests tab

sheets.title: A second tab, in the background — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: The same vault in a second tab that is not being looked at. Before, it stays as it was. After, its title says (1), its bell is lit with a card that says only that a request is waiting and keys to it, and one system notification rang whose body is the same for every request and whose data is { kind, action, ref } and nothing a request holds. No server was asked.
sheets.after: title "(1) OpenSesame"; bell 1; system notifications 1: "Request waiting" / "A request is waiting for you."

sheets.title: Access › Sessions › Receipts, after approval — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: The request is approved with the keyboard and the passkey. Before, Sessions has no Receipts on a device with no Identity session. After, the device keeps its own receipts, sealed and append-only, naming the application and never a scope, a reason or an address.
sheets.after: Receipts rows: 2 — "Request approved · Test application", "Request raised · Test application"

sheets.title: Settings › Capabilities, notifications — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: With no Identity API, the notifications section offered Push and Routing, which need one. After, those are withdrawn and the section is Local notifications: its own switch, and the two places the device can ring (system notifications, asked for only on that key; the tab's title and badge).
sheets.before: section "Notifications": Push notifications, Notification routing; 16 sections; policy cards "0 required · 25 optional"
sheets.after: section "Local notifications": System notifications, Tab title and badge; 17 sections; "0 required · 26 optional"
